library(mlr3website)
library(mlr3misc)
library(htmltools)
library(data.table)
library(reactable)

# Add Google Fonts programmatically
htmltools::tagList(
  tags$link(rel = "preconnect", href = "https://fonts.googleapis.com"),
  tags$link(rel = "preconnect", href = "https://fonts.gstatic.com", crossorigin = "anonymous"),
  tags$link(href = "https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto:wght@400;800&display=swap", rel = "stylesheet")
)
